title: Who am I? Guess Premier League star No 20
summary: BBC Football presents a guessing game challenging readers to identify a Premier League player wearing number 20. The feature tests fan knowledge with a limited number of attempts to correctly identify the mysterious player.
content: Work out the identity of today's player in as few attempts as possible.

zh.title: 我是谁？猜英超球星20号
zh.summary: BBC足球节目呈现一个猜谜游戏，挑战读者识别一位穿着20号球衣的英超球员。这个功能通过有限的尝试次数来测试球迷的知识，让他们正确识别神秘球员。

title: New season, new boss - will Alexander-Arnold be key figure at Real Madrid?
summary: Trent Alexander-Arnold enters his second season at Real Madrid under new manager Jose Mourinho, facing pressure to establish himself as a key figure for the club. The English defender must prove his worth in the new tactical system after a debut season that saw mixed results.
content: Trent Alexander-Arnold faces a defining second season at Real Madrid as he looks to prove his worth under Jose Mourinho.

zh.title: 新赛季，新主帅——亚历山大-阿诺德能否成为皇马的关键人物？
zh.summary: 特伦特·亚历山大-阿诺德在新主帅何塞·穆里尼奥麾下开始了他在皇家马德里的第二个赛季，面临着确立自己作为俱乐部关键人物的压力。这位英格兰后卫必须在新的战术体系中证明自己的价值，而他的首个赛季成绩参差不齐。
